errors.text_span: industry (brown), construction (blue), trade (red), and other services (dark blue)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly maps the color brown to industry and dark blue to other services. The image shows industry as yellow and other services as brown.
The description incorrectly assigns 19% (5.9 million) to other services in the 'NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES' chart. The image shows 19% (5.9 million) for trade, not other services.
The description incorrectly assigns 12% (3.7 million) to trade in the 'NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES' chart. The image shows 12% (3.7 million) for other services, not trade.
The description incorrectly assigns 51% (80.2 million) to other services in the 'NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED' chart. The image shows 51% (80.2 million) for industry, not other services.
The description incorrectly assigns 21% (33.0 million) to industry in the 'NUMBER OF PERSONS EMPLOYED' chart. The image shows 21% (33.0 million) for other services, not industry.
The description incorrectly assigns 33% (10.6 trillion) to industry in the 'TURNOVER' chart. The image shows 33% (10.6 trillion) for other services, not industry.
The description incorrectly assigns 31% (9.9 trillion) to other services in the 'TURNOVER' chart. The image shows 31% (9.9 trillion) for trade, not other services.
The description does not explicitly state that the sectors are not visually ordered by size.
